av.title: Auto volume
av.intro: Speaks up when the room is noisy and softly when it's quiet, and learns from the times you set the volume yourself. Only how loud the room is gets measured: nothing is recorded, kept or sent.
av.holding: Waiting while the device speaks, listens or plays
av.points: Times you set the volume yourself
av.curve.default: The default, until you have set the volume yourself a few times
av.forget.sure: Forget the volumes you have chosen and how loud this room usually is?
av.speech_only.hint: Music, radio and stories keep the volume you set yourself.
av.levels.hint: Used until it has learned your own volumes.
av.hold: After you set the volume yourself, leave it alone for
